# SpawnJob.com

> SpawnJob.com is a platform focused on job management and recruitment services with privacy-first data handling practices.

SpawnJob.com operates multiple service endpoints including AI-powered features (ai.spawnjob.com) and a web application (app.spawnjob.com). The platform prioritizes user privacy and GDPR compliance in its data collection and handling practices.

## Key Topics

- Privacy Policy
- Data Collection
- GDPR Compliance
- User Privacy
- Personal Information
- Terms of Service
- Device Data
- Log Data
- Job Management
- Recruitment
